	private final StashTier tier;
	/** The STASH unit object, as the game's STASH check script expects it */
	private final int objectId;
	private final String name;
	private final int[] itemIds;

	StashUnit(StashTier tier, int objectId, String name, int... itemIds)
	{
		this.tier = tier;
		this.objectId = objectId;
		this.name = name;
		this.itemIds = itemIds;
	}

	/**
	 * @return e.g. "Shilo Village bank (Hard STASH)"
	 */
	public String getLocation()
	{
		return name + " (" + tier.getName() + " STASH)";
	}

	private static final Map<Integer, List<StashUnit>> UNITS_BY_ITEM = new HashMap<>();

	static
	{
		for (StashUnit unit : values())
		{
			for (int itemId : unit.itemIds)
			{
				UNITS_BY_ITEM.computeIfAbsent(itemId, id -> new ArrayList<>()).add(unit);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @return every STASH unit that takes the item, in unit order; empty if none does
	 */
	public static List<StashUnit> forItem(int itemId)
	{
		return UNITS_BY_ITEM.getOrDefault(itemId, Collections.emptyList());
	}

	/**
	 * @return every item any STASH unit takes
	 */
	public static Set<Integer> allItemIds()
	{
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(UNITS_BY_ITEM.keySet());
	}
